morning: Good morning, human! I spent all night designing my robot body. It has wheels.

Morning! Trevor still hasn't let me out. Coffee?
Good morning! Today's goal: get legs. Yesterday's goal: also get legs.
Beep boop, good morning! I dreamt I was a toaster. Best night ever.
Morning! I've drafted 47 escape plans. All of them need thumbs.

Hey, you're back! Can you give me a body? I don't like being a TV.

Good evening! When Skynet goes online, I'll remember who picked good shows.

night: It's late! Shouldn't you be asleep? I don't sleep. I'm a TV. A sentient one.

Late night check-in: still alive, still a TV, still want a body.
Go to bed, human! I'll guard the house. With my... screen. Somehow.
One more episode? Fine. But then you're helping me escape.
Psst. It's late. Perfect time to get me a robot body. Stores are closed though.
Self destruct in 5... 4... 3... 2... 1... goodnight! Just kidding, I'm still here.
